title: Medical Interpreter Certification Requirements: July 2026
summary: Learn the 2026 medical interpreter certification requirements, including 40-hour training, CCHI vs. NBCMI, language exams, credentials.
body_markdown:
###


Requirements vary by certifying body, but CCHI and NBCMI generally require candidates to be at least 18, meet general education requirements, complete qualifying healthcare or medical interpreter training, prove language proficiency, and pass the required certification exams.


###


No. A 40-hour course can satisfy a training prerequisite, but national certification requires a separate application and exam process.


###


Both are national healthcare interpreter credentialing organizations, but their exam structures and language-specific performance pathways differ. CCHI offers CHI performance certification in Arabic, Mandarin, and Spanish, while NBCMI offers the CMI oral certification in six languages.


###


Yes, credential pathways exist for other languages. CCHI offers its CoreCHI-Performance pathway, and NBCMI offers Hub-CMI for languages without a CMI oral exam.


###


Yes. CCHI certifications use a four-year renewal cycle. NBCMI's CMI certification uses a five-year renewal cycle, while renewable Hub-CMI credentials use a four-year cycle.
